ko.title: 지난해 중산층 세입자 5명 중 1명 이상이 전월세를 완납하지 못했다는 새로운 도시연구소 보고서

segments.src: For years, the conversation about rent hardship in America focused mostly on lower-income households.
segments.tr: 수년 동안 미국의 주택 임차 어려움에 대한 논의는 대부분 저소득 가구에만 집중했다.

segments.src: A new report from the Urban Institute suggests the pressure is now reaching much further up the income ladder.
segments.tr: 도시연구소의 새로운 보고서는 이제 압박이 소득 계층 훨씬 위로까지 확대되고 있음을 시사한다.

segments.src: According to the organization's latest survey data, roughly 22% of middle-income renters said that at some point in 2025 they could not pay their full rent when it was due.
segments.tr: 해당 기관의 최신 설문 데이터에 따르면, 약 22%의 중산층 세입자가 2025년 언젠가 월세를 정시에 완납하지 못했다고 답했다.

segments.src: That is a sharp change from the year before, and it is a bigger jump than the one seen among lower-income renters.
segments.tr: 이는 전년 대비 급격한 변화이며, 저소득 세입자들에게서 보이는 상승 폭보다 더 크다.

segments.src: Here is what the findings say, who is affected, and why researchers are paying close attention.
segments.tr: 다음은 조사 결과, 영향을 받는 사람들, 그리고 연구자들이 주목하는 이유이다.

segments.src: ## The Key Numbers
segments.tr: ## 핵심 수치

segments.src: The findings come from the Urban Institute's Well-Being and Basic Needs Survey, which asked more than 10,000 adults about how they are managing everyday costs.
segments.tr: 조사 결과는 도시연구소의 웰빙 및 기본 욕구 설문에서 나온 것으로, 1만 명 이상의 성인을 대상으로 일상적인 비용을 어떻게 관리하고 있는지 물었다.

segments.src: The share of renters who said they were unable to pay the full amount of rent at least once in the year breaks down as follows:
segments.tr: 연 중 최소 한 번 이상 월세를 완납하지 못했다고 답한 세입자의 비율은 다음과 같다:

segments.src: | Renter group | Earlier figure | 2025 |
segments.tr: | 세입자 그룹 | 이전 수치 | 2025 |

segments.src: | Middle-income | about 14% (prior year) | about 22% |
| Lower-income | about 24% (2019) | about 28% |
| Higher-earning | about 5% (prior year) | about 7% |
segments.tr: | 고소득 | 약 5% (전년) | 약 7% |

segments.src: Two things stand out.
segments.tr: 두 가지가 눈에 띈다.

segments.src: First, middle-income renters saw a rise of roughly eight percentage points in a single year.
segments.tr: 먼저, 중산층 세입자는 단 1년 만에 약 8%포인트의 상승을 기록했다.

segments.src: Second, the increase for lower-income renters, while real, has been much more gradual: from about 24% in 2019 to about 28% in 2025.
segments.tr: 둘째, 저소득 세입자의 증가는 실질적이지만 훨씬 더 완만했다: 2019년 약 24%에서 2025년 약 28%로의 증가.

segments.src: Lower-income renters still report the highest overall rates of trouble paying rent, but the gap between the two groups is narrowing.
segments.tr: 저소득 세입자들은 여전히 월세 납부 곤란의 가장 높은 비율을 보고하고 있으나, 두 그룹 간의 격차는 좁혀지고 있다.

segments.src: ## Who Counts as "Middle-Income"?
segments.tr: ## "중산층"은 누구인가?

segments.src: The report defines middle-income adults by household size.
segments.tr: 보고서는 가구 규모에 따라 중산층 성인을 정의한다.

segments.src: For a single person, that means earning roughly $31,300 to $62,600 a year.
segments.tr: 1인 가구의 경우, 연간 약 $31,300~$62,600을 버는 것을 의미한다.

segments.src: For a family of three, the range is roughly $53,300 to $106,600.
Households in these ranges often earn too much to qualify for many housing assistance programs, yet not enough to absorb a sudden jump in rent, a rise in utility bills, or an unexpected expense.
segments.tr: 이 범위의 가구들은 많은 주택 지원 프로그램의 대상이 되기에는 너무 많이 버는 반면, 갑작스러운 월세 인상, 공과금 상승 또는 예상치 못한 비용을 감당하기에는 충분하지 않다.

segments.src: That makes them especially exposed when several costs climb at once.
segments.tr: 이것은 여러 비용이 동시에 상승할 때 특히 취약하게 만든다.

segments.src: ## What "Unable to Pay" Means
segments.tr: ## "완납하지 못함"의 의미

segments.src: In the survey, a renter counts as unable to pay if they could not cover the full amount of rent when it was due.
segments.tr: 설문에서 세입자가 월세 만기일에 월세 전액을 감당하지 못했다면 완납하지 못한 것으로 간주된다.

segments.src: That covers a range of situations, including a late payment, a partial payment, or a missed payment.
segments.tr: 여기에는 지연 납부, 부분 납부, 또는 미납 등 다양한 상황이 포함된다.

segments.src: Not every case ends in a formal eviction filing, and many households catch up later.
segments.tr: 모든 경우가 공식적인 퇴거 청구로 이어지지는 않으며, 많은 가구들은 나중에 납부를 따라잡는다.

segments.src: Still, researchers treat these moments as an early warning sign.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 연구자들은 이러한 순간들을 조기 경고 신호로 본다.

segments.src: Samantha Batko, a senior fellow at the Urban Institute and a co-author of the report, described the change this way: "This increase among middle-income renters is a big and important shift that reflects overall challenges with affordability in the country."
segments.tr: 보고서의 공동 저자이자 도시연구소의 선임 연구원 샘 배스코(Samantha Batko)는 이 변화를 이렇게 설명했다: "중산층 세입자들 사이의 이러한 증가는 국내 주택 가격 적정성과 관련된 전반적인 어려움을 반영하는 크고 중요한 변화다."

segments.src: She also noted that when a family reports a late, partial, or missed rent payment, those are choices happening in real time as households try to stretch their budgets.
segments.tr: 그녀는 또한 가족이 지연, 부분, 또는 미납을 보고할 때, 이것이 가구들이 예산을 절약하려고 할 때 실시간으로 일어나는 선택임을 지적했다.

segments.src: ## A Trend Specific to Renters
segments.tr: ## 세입자에게만 나타나는 추세

segments.src: The report points to a gap between renters and homeowners.
segments.tr: 보고서는 세입자와 주택 소유자 간의 격차를 지적한다.

segments.src: Homeowners' ability to afford their mortgage payments has stayed steady over the past seven years.
segments.tr: 주택 소유자의 담보대출 납부 능력은 지난 7년 동안 안정적으로 유지되었다.

segments.src: Rent hardship, by contrast, has been climbing since 2022.
segments.tr: 반면 월세 곤란은 2022년 이후 계속 증가하고 있다.

segments.src: Renters also reported strain beyond the rent itself.
segments.tr: 세입자들은 또한 월세 이외의 부담을 보고했다.

segments.src: More than 20% said they had trouble paying for utilities such as gas, oil, or electricity, which suggests that housing costs are only one part of a broader squeeze on household budgets.
segments.tr: 20% 이상이 가스, 기름, 전기 등의 공과금 납부에 어려움이 있다고 답했으며, 이는 주택 비용이 가구 예산에 대한 더 광범위한 압박의 일부일 뿐임을 시사한다.

segments.src: The survey also found that the sharpest increases in missed rent payments during 2025 came in the South and the Northeast.
segments.tr: 설문에서는 또한 2025년 월세 미납의 가장 가파른 증가가 남부와 북동부에서 나타났음을 발견했다.

segments.src: ## Why Researchers Are Concerned
segments.tr: ## 연구자들이 우려하는 이유

segments.src: The report ties the trend to mounting economic pressures and the rising cost of everyday necessities.
segments.tr: 보고서는 이 추세를 증가하는 경제 압박과 일상 필수품의 상승하는 비용에 연결한다.

segments.src: When groceries, transportation, insurance, and utilities all cost more, rent is often the largest bill to come up short.
segments.tr: 식료품, 교통, 보험, 공과금이 모두 더 비싸질 때, 월세가 종종 가장 큰 청구서로 부족해진다.

segments.src: Batko also raised a longer-term concern about the shift toward middle-income households, noting the potential implications for the number of people who could eventually lose their housing.
segments.tr: 배스코는 또한 중산층 가구로의 전환에 대한 장기적인 우려를 제기하면서, 결국 주택을 잃을 수 있는 사람들의 수에 대한 잠재적 영향을 언급했다.

segments.src: Households with more income often have more options, such as savings, credit, or help from family, and researchers watch closely for the point where those cushions run out.
segments.tr: 더 많은 소득을 가진 가구들은 종종 저축, 신용, 또는 가족의 도움과 같은 더 많은 선택지를 가지고 있으며, 연구자들은 이러한 완충재가 떨어지는 시점을 면밀히 지켜본다.

segments.src: ## A Note on the Numbers
segments.tr: ## 수치에 대한 참고

segments.src: Reports of this kind rely on self-reported survey responses, so the figures are best read as estimates of how many renters say they struggled, not a count of court filings or formal evictions.
segments.tr: 이러한 종류의 보고서는 자가 보고 설문 응답에 의존하므로, 수치는 법원 제출 또는 공식 퇴거 건수가 아닌 어려움을 겪었다고 말하는 세입자 수의 추정치로 가장 잘 읽힌다.

segments.src: Some news coverage has summarized the middle-income finding as "one in five," while the underlying data put it slightly higher, at about 22%.
segments.tr: 일부 언론 보도는 중산층 조사 결과를 "5명 중 1명"으로 요약했지만, 기초 데이터는 약 22%로 약간 더 높다.

segments.src: The direction of the trend is clear either way.
segments.tr: 추세의 방향은 어느 쪽이든 명확하다.

segments.src: ## What Renters Can Do
segments.tr: ## 세입자가 할 수 있는 것

segments.src: Housing costs are not something any one household can fix alone, but a few practical steps can help anyone who expects to fall behind:
segments.tr: 주택 비용은 단일 가구가 혼자 해결할 수 없는 문제이지만, 몇 가지 실질적인 단계는 뒤처질 것으로 예상되는 모든 사람을 도울 수 있다:

segments.src: - **Communicate early.** Landlords and property managers are often more willing to discuss a payment plan before a payment is missed than after.
segments.tr: - **일찍 연락하라.** 집주인과 부동산 관리자는 종종 미납 후보다 미납 전에 납부 계획에 대해 논의하려는 의향이 있다.

segments.src: - **Know your local options.** Many cities and counties run emergency rental assistance or mediation programs. Dialing 211 in most areas connects callers to local support services.
segments.tr: - **지역 선택지를 알아보라.** 많은 도시와 카운티는 긴급 임차 지원 또는 중재 프로그램을 운영한다. 대부분의 지역에서 211에 전화하면 지역 지원 서비스에 연결된다.

segments.src: - **Seek free housing counseling.** HUD-approved housing counseling agencies offer free or low-cost guidance. A directory is available at hud.gov.
segments.tr: - **무료 주택 상담을 찾아보라.** HUD 승인 주택 상담 기관은 무료 또는 저가의 상담을 제공한다. 디렉토리는 hud.gov에서 이용할 수 있다.

segments.src: - **Review the lease.** Understanding late-fee rules and notice requirements in your state can help you plan.
segments.tr: - **임차 계약서를 검토하라.** 해당 주의 지연료 규칙과 통지 요건을 이해하면 계획을 세우는 데 도움이 될 수 있다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 핵심 요약

segments.src: The Urban Institute's findings add to a growing body of evidence that housing affordability is no longer only a low-income issue.
segments.tr: 도시연구소의 조사 결과는 주택 가격 적정성이 더 이상 저소득층의 문제만이 아님을 보여주는 증거가 늘어나고 있음을 더한다.

segments.src: With about 22% of middle-income renters reporting a missed or incomplete rent payment last year, the strain now reaches households that were once considered financially secure.
segments.tr: 약 22%의 중산층 세입자가 지난해 월세 미납 또는 부분 납부를 보고하면서, 이제 그 부담이 예전에는 재정적으로 안정적으로 여겨지던 가구까지 미치고 있다.

segments.src: Whether the trend continues will depend on rents, wages, and the cost of other basics in the months ahead.
segments.tr: 추세가 계속될지 여부는 향후 몇 개월 동안의 월세, 임금 및 기타 기본 비용에 달려 있을 것이다.

segments.src: *Source: Urban Institute Well-Being and Basic Needs Survey, as reported by [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/09/23/nx-s1-5977022/rent-affordability-middle-income) on September 23, 2026.
segments.tr: *출처: 2026년 9월 23일 [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/09/23/nx-s1-5977022/rent-affordability-middle-income)에서 보도한 도시연구소 웰빙 및 기본 욕구 설문.

segments.src: This article is for general information only and does not constitute financial or legal advice.*
segments.tr: 이 기사는 일반 정보만을 위한 것이며 재정적 또는 법적 조언을 구성하지 않는다.*

zh.title: 超过五分之一的中等收入租房者去年未能全额支付房租，城市研究所的新报告发现

segments.src: For years, the conversation about rent hardship in America focused mostly on lower-income households.
segments.tr: 多年来，美国关于租赁困难的讨论主要集中在低收入家庭。

segments.src: A new report from the Urban Institute suggests the pressure is now reaching much further up the income ladder.
segments.tr: 城市研究所的一份新报告表明，这种压力现在已经蔓延到更高收入阶层。

segments.src: According to the organization's latest survey data, roughly 22% of middle-income renters said that at some point in 2025 they could not pay their full rent when it was due.
segments.tr: 根据该组织的最新调查数据，大约22%的中等收入租房者表示，在2025年的某个时刻无法在应付时全额支付房租。

segments.src: That is a sharp change from the year before, and it is a bigger jump than the one seen among lower-income renters.
segments.tr: 这是相比前一年的急剧变化，而且比低收入租房者中看到的增幅更大。

segments.src: Here is what the findings say, who is affected, and why researchers are paying close attention.
segments.tr: 以下是调查结果所说的内容、受影响的人群，以及研究人员密切关注的原因。

segments.src: ## The Key Numbers
segments.tr: ## 关键数据

segments.src: The findings come from the Urban Institute's Well-Being and Basic Needs Survey, which asked more than 10,000 adults about how they are managing everyday costs.
segments.tr: 这些调查结果来自城市研究所的幸福感和基本需求调查，该调查询问了10,000多位成年人他们如何管理日常开支。

segments.src: The share of renters who said they were unable to pay the full amount of rent at least once in the year breaks down as follows:
segments.tr: 表示在该年至少有一次无法支付全额房租的租房者比例分解如下：

segments.src: | Renter group | Earlier figure | 2025 |
segments.tr: | 租房者群体 | 早期数据 | 2025年 |

segments.src: | Middle-income | about 14% (prior year) | about 22% |
segments.tr: | 中等收入 | 约14%（前一年） | 约22% |

segments.src: | Lower-income | about 24% (2019) | about 28% |
| Higher-earning | about 5% (prior year) | about 7% |
segments.tr: | 高收入 | 约5%（前一年） | 约7% |

segments.src: Two things stand out.
segments.tr: 有两点突出。

segments.src: First, middle-income renters saw a rise of roughly eight percentage points in a single year.
segments.tr: 首先，中等收入租房者在一年内上升了大约8个百分点。

segments.src: Second, the increase for lower-income renters, while real, has been much more gradual: from about 24% in 2019 to about 28% in 2025.
segments.tr: 其次，低收入租房者的增幅虽然真实，但增长要缓得多：从2019年的约24%增加到2025年的约28%。

segments.src: Lower-income renters still report the highest overall rates of trouble paying rent, but the gap between the two groups is narrowing.
segments.tr: 低收入租房者仍然报告了最高的总体房租支付困难率，但两个群体之间的差距正在缩小。

segments.src: ## Who Counts as "Middle-Income"?
segments.tr: ## 谁被算作"中等收入"？

segments.src: The report defines middle-income adults by household size.
segments.tr: 该报告根据家庭规模定义中等收入成年人。

segments.src: For a single person, that means earning roughly $31,300 to $62,600 a year.
segments.tr: 对于单身人士，这意味着每年收入大约$31,300到$62,600。

segments.src: For a family of three, the range is roughly $53,300 to $106,600.
segments.tr: 对于三人家庭，范围大约是$53,300到$106,600。

segments.src: Households in these ranges often earn too much to qualify for many housing assistance programs, yet not enough to absorb a sudden jump in rent, a rise in utility bills, or an unexpected expense.
segments.tr: 这些收入范围内的家庭通常收入过高而不符合许多住房援助计划的条件，但又不足以吸收房租突然上升、公用事业费用增加或意外支出。

segments.src: That makes them especially exposed when several costs climb at once.
segments.tr: 当多个成本同时上升时，这使他们特别容易受到影响。

segments.src: ## What "Unable to Pay" Means
segments.tr: ## "无法支付"的含义

segments.src: In the survey, a renter counts as unable to pay if they could not cover the full amount of rent when it was due.
segments.tr: 在调查中，如果租房者无法在应付时支付全额房租，则被计为无法支付。

segments.src: That covers a range of situations, including a late payment, a partial payment, or a missed payment.
segments.tr: 这涵盖了一系列情况，包括逾期支付、部分支付或未支付。

segments.src: Not every case ends in a formal eviction filing, and many households catch up later.
segments.tr: 并非每种情况都会以正式驱逐申请结束，许多家庭稍后会赶上。

segments.src: Still, researchers treat these moments as an early warning sign.
segments.tr: 不过，研究人员将这些时刻视为早期警告信号。

segments.src: Samantha Batko, a senior fellow at the Urban Institute and a co-author of the report, described the change this way: "This increase among middle-income renters is a big and important shift that reflects overall challenges with affordability in the country."
segments.tr: 城市研究所资深研究员、报告共同作者Samantha Batko这样描述了这一变化："中等收入租房者中的增加是一个重大而重要的转变，反映了全国整体可负担性面临的挑战。"

segments.src: She also noted that when a family reports a late, partial, or missed rent payment, those are choices happening in real time as households try to stretch their budgets.
segments.tr: 她还指出，当一个家庭报告逾期、部分或未支付房租时，这些是家庭试图拉长预算时实时发生的选择。

segments.src: ## A Trend Specific to Renters
segments.tr: ## 租房者特有的趋势

segments.src: The report points to a gap between renters and homeowners.
segments.tr: 该报告指出了租房者和房主之间的差距。

segments.src: Homeowners' ability to afford their mortgage payments has stayed steady over the past seven years.
segments.tr: 房主承担抵押贷款支付的能力在过去七年中保持稳定。

segments.src: Rent hardship, by contrast, has been climbing since 2022.
segments.tr: 相比之下，房租困难自2022年以来一直在上升。

segments.src: Renters also reported strain beyond the rent itself.
segments.tr: 租房者也报告了超出房租本身的压力。

segments.src: More than 20% said they had trouble paying for utilities such as gas, oil, or electricity, which suggests that housing costs are only one part of a broader squeeze on household budgets.
segments.tr: 超过20%的人表示在支付燃气、油或电等公用事业费用方面遇到困难，这表明住房成本只是对家庭预算更广泛挤压的一部分。

segments.src: The survey also found that the sharpest increases in missed rent payments during 2025 came in the South and the Northeast.
segments.tr: 调查还发现，2025年期间错过房租支付的最大增幅出现在南方和东北地区。

segments.src: ## Why Researchers Are Concerned
segments.tr: ## 研究人员为何关切

segments.src: The report ties the trend to mounting economic pressures and the rising cost of everyday necessities.
segments.tr: 该报告将这一趋势与不断增加的经济压力和日常必需品成本上升联系起来。

segments.src: When groceries, transportation, insurance, and utilities all cost more, rent is often the largest bill to come up short.
segments.tr: 当食品杂货、交通、保险和公用事业成本都上升时，房租通常是最大的短缺账单。

segments.src: Batko also raised a longer-term concern about the shift toward middle-income households, noting the potential implications for the number of people who could eventually lose their housing.
segments.tr: Batko还对中等收入家庭转变提出了长期关切，指出了对最终可能失去住房的人数潜在影响的关注。

segments.src: Households with more income often have more options, such as savings, credit, or help from family, and researchers watch closely for the point where those cushions run out.
segments.tr: 收入更高的家庭通常有更多选择，例如储蓄、信用或家庭帮助，研究人员密切关注这些缓冲耗尽的时刻。

segments.src: ## A Note on the Numbers
segments.tr: ## 关于数字的说明

segments.src: Reports of this kind rely on self-reported survey responses, so the figures are best read as estimates of how many renters say they struggled, not a count of court filings or formal evictions.
segments.tr: 这类报告依赖于自我报告的调查回复，因此数据最好理解为估计有多少租房者表示他们在努力，而不是法院申请或正式驱逐的计数。

segments.src: Some news coverage has summarized the middle-income finding as "one in five," while the underlying data put it slightly higher, at about 22%.
segments.tr: 一些新闻报道将中等收入的发现总结为"五分之一"，而基础数据略高，约为22%。

segments.src: The direction of the trend is clear either way.
segments.tr: 无论哪种方式，趋势的方向都很明确。

segments.src: ## What Renters Can Do
segments.tr: ## 租房者可以做什么

segments.src: Housing costs are not something any one household can fix alone, but a few practical steps can help anyone who expects to fall behind:
segments.tr: 住房成本不是任何一个家庭都能单独解决的问题，但几个实际步骤可以帮助任何预期会落后的人：

segments.src: - **Communicate early.** Landlords and property managers are often more willing to discuss a payment plan before a payment is missed than after.
segments.tr: - **提前沟通。** 房东和物业经理通常更愿意在未支付前讨论支付计划，而不是在支付后。

segments.src: - **Know your local options.** Many cities and counties run emergency rental assistance or mediation programs. Dialing 211 in most areas connects callers to local support services.
segments.tr: - **了解你的本地选择。** 许多城市和县运营紧急租赁援助或调解计划。在大多数地区拨打211可以连接到本地支持服务。

segments.src: - **Seek free housing counseling.** HUD-approved housing counseling agencies offer free or low-cost guidance. A directory is available at hud.gov.
segments.tr: - **寻求免费住房咨询。** HUD批准的住房咨询机构提供免费或低成本的指导。目录可在hud.gov获得。

segments.src: - **Review the lease.** Understanding late-fee rules and notice requirements in your state can help you plan.
segments.tr: - **审查租约。** 了解你所在州的逾期费用规则和通知要求可以帮助你进行规划。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The Urban Institute's findings add to a growing body of evidence that housing affordability is no longer only a low-income issue.
segments.tr: 城市研究所的调查结果增加了越来越多的证据，表明住房可负担性不再仅仅是低收入问题。

segments.src: With about 22% of middle-income renters reporting a missed or incomplete rent payment last year, the strain now reaches households that were once considered financially secure.
segments.tr: 约22%的中等收入租房者报告去年有错过或不完整的房租支付，这种压力现在影响到曾被认为在财务上有保障的家庭。

segments.src: Whether the trend continues will depend on rents, wages, and the cost of other basics in the months ahead.
segments.tr: 趋势是否继续将取决于未来几个月的房租、工资和其他基本生活成本。

segments.src: *Source: Urban Institute Well-Being and Basic Needs Survey, as reported by [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/09/23/nx-s1-5977022/rent-affordability-middle-income) on September 23, 2026.
segments.tr: *来源：城市研究所幸福感和基本需求调查，由[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/09/23/nx-s1-5977022/rent-affordability-middle-income)于2026年9月23日报道。

segments.src: This article is for general information only and does not constitute financial or legal advice.*
segments.tr: 本文仅供一般信息之用，不构成财务或法律建议。*

hi.title: 1 में 5 से अधिक मध्यम आय वाले किराएदारों ने पिछले साल पूरा किराया भुगतान नहीं किया, नई अर्बन इंस्टीट्यूट रिपोर्ट में पता चला

segments.src: For years, the conversation about rent hardship in America focused mostly on lower-income households.
segments.tr: वर्षों से, अमेरिका में किराए की कठिनाई के बारे में बातचीत मुख्य रूप से निम्न आय वाले परिवारों पर केंद्रित थी।

segments.src: A new report from the Urban Institute suggests the pressure is now reaching much further up the income ladder.
segments.tr: अर्बन इंस्टीट्यूट की एक नई रिपोर्ट बताती है कि दबाव अब आय सीढ़ी पर बहुत आगे तक पहुंच रहा है।

segments.src: According to the organization's latest survey data, roughly 22% of middle-income renters said that at some point in 2025 they could not pay their full rent when it was due.
segments.tr: संगठन के नवीनतम सर्वेक्षण डेटा के अनुसार, लगभग 22% मध्यम आय वाले किराएदारों ने कहा कि 2025 में किसी बिंदु पर वे अपना पूरा किराया समय पर नहीं दे सके।

segments.src: That is a sharp change from the year before, and it is a bigger jump than the one seen among lower-income renters.
segments.tr: यह पिछले साल से एक तेज बदलाव है, और यह निम्न आय वाले किराएदारों के बीच देखे गए से बड़ी छलांग है।

segments.src: Here is what the findings say, who is affected, and why researchers are paying close attention.
segments.tr: यहाँ बताया गया है कि निष्कर्ष क्या कहते हैं, कौन प्रभावित है, और शोधकर्ता ध्यान क्यों दे रहे हैं।

segments.src: ## The Key Numbers
segments.tr: ## मुख्य संख्याएँ

segments.src: The findings come from the Urban Institute's Well-Being and Basic Needs Survey, which asked more than 10,000 adults about how they are managing everyday costs.
segments.tr: निष्कर्ष अर्बन इंस्टीट्यूट के वेल-बीइंग और बेसिक नीड्स सर्वे से आते हैं, जिसने 10,000 से अधिक वयस्कों से पूछा कि वे दैनिक खर्चों को कैसे संभाल रहे हैं।

segments.src: The share of renters who said they were unable to pay the full amount of rent at least once in the year breaks down as follows:
segments.tr: किराएदारों का हिस्सा जो कहते हैं कि वे वर्ष में कम से कम एक बार किराए की पूरी राशि का भुगतान करने में असमर्थ थे, निम्नानुसार टूट जाता है:

segments.src: | Renter group | Earlier figure | 2025 |
segments.tr: | किराएदार समूह | पहले का आंकड़ा | 2025 |

segments.src: | Middle-income | about 14% (prior year) | about 22% |
segments.tr: | मध्यम आय | लगभग 14% (पिछला साल) | लगभग 22% |

segments.src: | Lower-income | about 24% (2019) | about 28% |
segments.tr: | निम्न आय | लगभग 24% (2019) | लगभग 28% |

segments.src: | Higher-earning | about 5% (prior year) | about 7% |
segments.tr: | उच्च आय | लगभग 5% (पिछला साल) | लगभग 7% |

segments.src: Two things stand out.
segments.tr: दो चीजें सामने आती हैं।

segments.src: First, middle-income renters saw a rise of roughly eight percentage points in a single year.
segments.tr: पहली बात यह है कि मध्यम आय वाले किराएदारों ने एक साल में लगभग आठ प्रतिशत अंक की वृद्धि देखी।

segments.src: Second, the increase for lower-income renters, while real, has been much more gradual: from about 24% in 2019 to about 28% in 2025.
segments.tr: दूसरी बात यह है कि निम्न आय वाले किराएदारों के लिए वृद्धि, हालांकि वास्तविक है, बहुत अधिक क्रमिक है: 2019 में लगभग 24% से 2025 में लगभग 28% तक।

segments.src: Lower-income renters still report the highest overall rates of trouble paying rent, but the gap between the two groups is narrowing.
segments.tr: निम्न आय वाले किराएदार अभी भी किराया भुगतान करने में कठिनाई की उच्चतम दरों की रिपोर्ट करते हैं, लेकिन दोनों समूहों के बीच का अंतर कम हो रहा है।

segments.src: ## Who Counts as "Middle-Income"?
segments.tr: ## "मध्यम आय" के रूप में कौन गिना जाता है?

segments.src: The report defines middle-income adults by household size.
segments.tr: रिपोर्ट घरेलू आकार द्वारा मध्यम आय वाले वयस्कों को परिभाषित करती है।

segments.src: For a single person, that means earning roughly $31,300 to $62,600 a year.
segments.tr: एक अकेले व्यक्ति के लिए, इसका मतलब है कि प्रति वर्ष लगभग $31,300 से $62,600 अर्जित करना।

segments.src: For a family of three, the range is roughly $53,300 to $106,600.
segments.tr: तीन के परिवार के लिए, सीमा लगभग $53,300 से $106,600 है।

segments.src: Households in these ranges often earn too much to qualify for many housing assistance programs, yet not enough to absorb a sudden jump in rent, a rise in utility bills, or an unexpected expense.
segments.tr: इन सीमाओं में घरों को अक्सर कई आवास सहायता कार्यक्रमों के लिए योग्य होने के लिए बहुत अधिक कमाई होती है, फिर भी किराए में अचानक वृद्धि, उपयोगिता बिलों में वृद्धि, या अप्रत्याशित खर्च को अवशोषित करने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।

segments.src: That makes them especially exposed when several costs climb at once.
segments.tr: यह उन्हें विशेष रूप से उजागर करता है जब कई लागतें एक साथ बढ़ती हैं।

segments.src: ## What "Unable to Pay" Means
segments.tr: ## "भुगतान करने में असमर्थ" का क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: In the survey, a renter counts as unable to pay if they could not cover the full amount of rent when it was due.
segments.tr: सर्वेक्षण में, एक किराएदार को भुगतान करने में असमर्थ के रूप में गिना जाता है यदि वे किराए की पूरी राशि को समय पर कवर नहीं कर सकते थे।

segments.src: That covers a range of situations, including a late payment, a partial payment, or a missed payment.
segments.tr: यह विभिन्न परिस्थितियों को कवर करता है, जिसमें देर से भुगतान, आंशिक भुगतान, या चूक किया गया भुगतान शामिल है।

segments.src: Not every case ends in a formal eviction filing, and many households catch up later.
segments.tr: हर मामला औपचारिक बेदखली दाखिल करने के साथ समाप्त नहीं होता है, और कई घर बाद में पकड़ते हैं।

segments.src: Still, researchers treat these moments as an early warning sign.
segments.tr: फिर भी, शोधकर्ता इन पलों को एक प्रारंभिक चेतावनी संकेत के रूप में मानते हैं।

segments.src: Samantha Batko, a senior fellow at the Urban Institute and a co-author of the report, described the change this way: "This increase among middle-income renters is a big and important shift that reflects overall challenges with affordability in the country."
segments.tr: सामंथा बाटको, अर्बन इंस्टीट्यूट में एक वरिष्ठ फेलो और रिपोर्ट के सह-लेखक, ने इस बदलाव को इस तरह वर्णित किया: "मध्यम आय वाले किराएदारों में यह वृद्धि एक बड़ी और महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव है जो देश में सामर्थ्य की समग्र चुनौतियों को प्रतिबिंबित करता है।"

segments.src: She also noted that when a family reports a late, partial, or missed rent payment, those are choices happening in real time as households try to stretch their budgets.
segments.tr: उन्होंने यह भी नोट किया कि जब कोई परिवार देर से, आंशिक, या चूक किए गए किराया भुगतान की रिपोर्ट करता है, तो ये वास्तविक समय में होने वाले विकल्प हैं क्योंकि घर अपने बजट को खींचने का प्रयास करते हैं।

segments.src: ## A Trend Specific to Renters
segments.tr: ## किराएदारों के लिए विशिष्ट एक प्रवृत्ति

segments.src: The report points to a gap between renters and homeowners.
segments.tr: रिपोर्ट किराएदारों और घर मालिकों के बीच एक अंतर की ओर इशारा करती है।

segments.src: Homeowners' ability to afford their mortgage payments has stayed steady over the past seven years.
segments.tr: घर मालिकों की बंधक भुगतान का खर्च उठाने की क्षमता पिछले सात वर्षों में स्थिर रही है।

segments.src: Rent hardship, by contrast, has been climbing since 2022.
segments.tr: इसके विपरीत, किराए की कठिनाई 2022 से बढ़ रही है।

segments.src: Renters also reported strain beyond the rent itself.
segments.tr: किराएदारों ने किराए के अलावा तनाव की भी रिपोर्ट की।

segments.src: More than 20% said they had trouble paying for utilities such as gas, oil, or electricity, which suggests that housing costs are only one part of a broader squeeze on household budgets.
segments.tr: 20% से अधिक लोगों ने कहा कि उन्हें गैस, तेल, या बिजली जैसी उपयोगिताओं के लिए भुगतान करने में कठिनाई है, जो सुझाव देता है कि आवास लागत घरेलू बजट पर एक व्यापक निचोड़ का केवल एक हिस्सा है।

segments.src: The survey also found that the sharpest increases in missed rent payments during 2025 came in the South and the Northeast.
segments.tr: सर्वेक्षण में यह भी पाया गया कि 2025 में चूक किए गए किराया भुगतान में सबसे तेज वृद्धि दक्षिण और उत्तरपूर्व में आई।

segments.src: ## Why Researchers Are Concerned
segments.tr: ## शोधकर्ता चिंतित क्यों हैं

segments.src: The report ties the trend to mounting economic pressures and the rising cost of everyday necessities.
segments.tr: रिपोर्ट इस प्रवृत्ति को बढ़ते आर्थिक दबाव और दैनिक आवश्यकताओं की बढ़ती लागत से जोड़ती है।

segments.src: When groceries, transportation, insurance, and utilities all cost more, rent is often the largest bill to come up short.
segments.tr: जब किराने का सामान, परिवहन, बीमा, और उपयोगिताएं सभी अधिक खर्चीली हों, तो किराया अक्सर सबसे बड़ा बिल है जो कम पड़ता है।

segments.src: Batko also raised a longer-term concern about the shift toward middle-income households, noting the potential implications for the number of people who could eventually lose their housing.
segments.tr: बाटको ने मध्यम आय वाले घरों की ओर बदलाव के बारे में एक दीर्घकालीन चिंता भी उठाई, जिससे उन लोगों की संख्या के लिए संभावित प्रभाव नोट किए गए जो अंत में अपना आवास खो सकते हैं।

segments.src: Households with more income often have more options, such as savings, credit, or help from family, and researchers watch closely for the point where those cushions run out.
segments.tr: अधिक आय वाले घरों के पास अक्सर अधिक विकल्प होते हैं, जैसे बचत, क्रेडिट, या परिवार की मदद, और शोधकर्ता उस बिंदु के लिए बारीकी से देखते हैं जहां वे तकिए समाप्त हो जाते हैं।

segments.src: ## A Note on the Numbers
segments.tr: ## संख्याओं पर एक नोट

segments.src: Reports of this kind rely on self-reported survey responses, so the figures are best read as estimates of how many renters say they struggled, not a count of court filings or formal evictions.
segments.tr: इस तरह की रिपोर्टें स्व-रिपोर्ट किए गए सर्वेक्षण प्रतिक्रियाओं पर निर्भर करती हैं, इसलिए आंकड़े सबसे अच्छे ढंग से पढ़े जाते हैं कि कितने किराएदार कहते हैं कि वे संघर्ष कर रहे थे, न कि अदालत की दाखिलों या औपचारिक बेदखली की गिनती।

segments.src: Some news coverage has summarized the middle-income finding as "one in five," while the underlying data put it slightly higher, at about 22%.
segments.tr: कुछ समाचार कवरेज ने मध्यम आय की खोज को "पाँचों में से एक" के रूप में सारांशित किया है, जबकि अंतर्निहित डेटा इसे थोड़ा अधिक रखता है, लगभग 22%।

segments.src: The direction of the trend is clear either way.
segments.tr: प्रवृत्ति की दिशा किसी भी तरह से स्पष्ट है।

segments.src: ## What Renters Can Do
segments.tr: ## किराएदार क्या कर सकते हैं

segments.src: Housing costs are not something any one household can fix alone, but a few practical steps can help anyone who expects to fall behind:
segments.tr: आवास लागत कुछ ऐसी नहीं है जो कोई एक घर अकेले ठीक कर सकता है, लेकिन कुछ व्यावहारिक कदम किसी को भी मदद कर सकते हैं जो पिछड़ने की उम्मीद करता है:

segments.src: - **Communicate early.** Landlords and property managers are often more willing to discuss a payment plan before a payment is missed than after.
segments.tr: - **जल्दी संचार करें।** जमींदार और संपत्ति प्रबंधक अक्सर भुगतान के बाद की तुलना में भुगतान से पहले एक भुगतान योजना पर चर्चा करने के लिए अधिक इच्छुक होते हैं।

segments.src: - **Know your local options.** Many cities and counties run emergency rental assistance or mediation programs. Dialing 211 in most areas connects callers to local support services.
segments.tr: - **अपने स्थानीय विकल्पों को जानें।** कई शहर और काउंटी आपातकालीन किराया सहायता या मध्यस्थता कार्यक्रम चलाते हैं। अधिकांश क्षेत्रों में 211 को डायल करने से कॉलर्स को स्थानीय सहायता सेवाओं से जोड़ा जाता है।

segments.src: - **Seek free housing counseling.** HUD-approved housing counseling agencies offer free or low-cost guidance. A directory is available at hud.gov.
segments.tr: - **मुक्त आवास परामर्श प्राप्त करें।** HUD-अनुमोदित आवास परामर्श एजेंसियां मुक्त या कम लागत वाली मार्गदर्शन प्रदान करती हैं। एक निर्देशिका hud.gov पर उपलब्ध है।

segments.src: - **Review the lease.** Understanding late-fee rules and notice requirements in your state can help you plan.
segments.tr: - **पट्टे की समीक्षा करें।** आपकी स्थिति में देर से फीस नियम और नोटिस आवश्यकताओं को समझने से आपको योजना बनाने में मदद मिल सकती है।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निचली लाइन

segments.src: The Urban Institute's findings add to a growing body of evidence that housing affordability is no longer only a low-income issue.
segments.tr: अर्बन इंस्टीट्यूट के निष्कर्ष साक्ष्य के एक बढ़ते शरीर में जोड़ते हैं कि आवास सामर्थ्य अब केवल एक निम्न आय समस्या नहीं है।

segments.src: With about 22% of middle-income renters reporting a missed or incomplete rent payment last year, the strain now reaches households that were once considered financially secure.
segments.tr: पिछले साल लगभग 22% मध्यम आय वाले किराएदारों द्वारा चूक किए गए या अधूरे किराया भुगतान की रिपोर्ट के साथ, तनाव अब उन घरों तक पहुंचता है जिन्हें कभी वित्तीय रूप से सुरक्षित माना जाता था।

segments.src: Whether the trend continues will depend on rents, wages, and the cost of other basics in the months ahead.
segments.tr: क्या प्रवृत्ति जारी रहेगी यह किराए, मजदूरी, और आने वाले महीनों में अन्य बेसिक की लागत पर निर्भर करेगा।

segments.src: *Source: Urban Institute Well-Being and Basic Needs Survey, as reported by [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/09/23/nx-s1-5977022/rent-affordability-middle-income) on September 23, 2026.

es.title: Más de 1 de cada 5 inquilinos de ingresos medios no pagaron el alquiler completo el año pasado, según nuevo informe del Urban Institute

segments.src: For years, the conversation about rent hardship in America focused mostly on lower-income households.
segments.tr: Durante años, la conversación sobre las dificultades de pago de alquiler en América se centró principalmente en hogares de bajos ingresos.

segments.src: A new report from the Urban Institute suggests the pressure is now reaching much further up the income ladder.
segments.tr: Un nuevo informe del Urban Institute sugiere que la presión ahora está llegando mucho más arriba en la escala de ingresos.

segments.src: According to the organization's latest survey data, roughly 22% of middle-income renters said that at some point in 2025 they could not pay their full rent when it was due.
segments.tr: Según los datos de la encuesta más reciente de la organización, aproximadamente el 22% de los inquilinos de ingresos medios dijeron que en algún momento en 2025 no pudieron pagar su alquiler completo cuando vencía.

segments.src: That is a sharp change from the year before, and it is a bigger jump than the one seen among lower-income renters.
segments.tr: Ese es un cambio drástico respecto al año anterior, y es un salto mayor que el observado entre los inquilinos de bajos ingresos.

segments.src: Here is what the findings say, who is affected, and why researchers are paying close attention.
segments.tr: Esto es lo que dicen los hallazgos, quién se ve afectado y por qué los investigadores están prestando mucha atención.

segments.src: ## The Key Numbers
segments.tr: ## Los números clave

segments.src: The findings come from the Urban Institute's Well-Being and Basic Needs Survey, which asked more than 10,000 adults about how they are managing everyday costs.
segments.tr: Los hallazgos provienen de la Encuesta de Bienestar y Necesidades Básicas del Urban Institute, que preguntó a más de 10,000 adultos cómo están manejando los gastos cotidianos.

segments.src: The share of renters who said they were unable to pay the full amount of rent at least once in the year breaks down as follows:
segments.tr: La proporción de inquilinos que dijeron que no pudieron pagar la cantidad completa de alquiler al menos una vez en el año se desglose de la siguiente manera:

segments.src: | Renter group | Earlier figure | 2025 |
segments.tr: | Grupo de inquilinos | Cifra anterior | 2025 |

segments.src: | Middle-income | about 14% (prior year) | about 22% |
segments.tr: | Ingresos medios | aproximadamente 14% (año anterior) | aproximadamente 22% |

segments.src: | Lower-income | about 24% (2019) | about 28% |
segments.tr: | Bajos ingresos | aproximadamente 24% (2019) | aproximadamente 28% |

segments.src: | Higher-earning | about 5% (prior year) | about 7% |
segments.tr: | Ingresos altos | aproximadamente 5% (año anterior) | aproximadamente 7% |

segments.src: Two things stand out.
segments.tr: Dos cosas destacan.

segments.src: First, middle-income renters saw a rise of roughly eight percentage points in a single year.
segments.tr: Primero, los inquilinos de ingresos medios vieron un aumento de aproximadamente ocho puntos porcentuales en un solo año.

segments.src: Second, the increase for lower-income renters, while real, has been much more gradual: from about 24% in 2019 to about 28% in 2025.
segments.tr: Segundo, el aumento para los inquilinos de bajos ingresos, aunque real, ha sido mucho más gradual: de aproximadamente 24% en 2019 a aproximadamente 28% en 2025.

segments.src: Lower-income renters still report the highest overall rates of trouble paying rent, but the gap between the two groups is narrowing.
segments.tr: Los inquilinos de bajos ingresos aún informan las tasas generales más altas de dificultades para pagar el alquiler, pero la brecha entre los dos grupos se está reduciendo.

segments.src: ## Who Counts as "Middle-Income"?
segments.tr: ## ¿Quién se considera de "ingresos medios"?

segments.src: The report defines middle-income adults by household size.
segments.tr: El informe define a los adultos de ingresos medios por el tamaño del hogar.

segments.src: For a single person, that means earning roughly $31,300 to $62,600 a year.
segments.tr: Para una sola persona, eso significa ganar aproximadamente $31,300 a $62,600 al año.

segments.src: For a family of three, the range is roughly $53,300 to $106,600.
segments.tr: Para una familia de tres, el rango es aproximadamente $53,300 a $106,600.

segments.src: Households in these ranges often earn too much to qualify for many housing assistance programs, yet not enough to absorb a sudden jump in rent, a rise in utility bills, or an unexpected expense.
segments.tr: Los hogares en estos rangos a menudo ganan demasiado para calificar para muchos programas de asistencia de vivienda, pero no lo suficiente para absorber un aumento repentino del alquiler, un aumento en las facturas de servicios o un gasto inesperado.

segments.src: That makes them especially exposed when several costs climb at once.
segments.tr: Eso los expone especialmente cuando varios costos suben a la vez.

segments.src: ## What "Unable to Pay" Means
segments.tr: ## Qué significa "No poder pagar"

segments.src: In the survey, a renter counts as unable to pay if they could not cover the full amount of rent when it was due.
segments.tr: En la encuesta, se considera que un inquilino no puede pagar si no pudo cubrir la cantidad completa de alquiler cuando vencía.

segments.src: That covers a range of situations, including a late payment, a partial payment, or a missed payment.
segments.tr: Eso cubre una variedad de situaciones, incluyendo un pago atrasado, un pago parcial o un pago omitido.

segments.src: Not every case ends in a formal eviction filing, and many households catch up later.
segments.tr: No todos los casos terminan en un desahucio formal, y muchos hogares se ponen al día más tarde.

segments.src: Still, researchers treat these moments as an early warning sign.
segments.tr: Aún así, los investigadores tratan estos momentos como una señal de alerta temprana.

segments.src: Samantha Batko, a senior fellow at the Urban Institute and a co-author of the report, described the change this way: "This increase among middle-income renters is a big and important shift that reflects overall challenges with affordability in the country."
segments.tr: Samantha Batko, investigadora senior del Urban Institute y coautora del informe, describió el cambio de esta manera: "Este aumento entre los inquilinos de ingresos medios es un cambio grande e importante que refleja los desafíos generales de asequibilidad en el país."

segments.src: She also noted that when a family reports a late, partial, or missed rent payment, those are choices happening in real time as households try to stretch their budgets.
segments.tr: También señaló que cuando una familia informa un pago de alquiler atrasado, parcial u omitido, esas son decisiones que ocurren en tiempo real mientras los hogares intentan estirar sus presupuestos.

segments.src: ## A Trend Specific to Renters
segments.tr: ## Una tendencia específica de los inquilinos

segments.src: The report points to a gap between renters and homeowners.
segments.tr: El informe señala una brecha entre inquilinos y propietarios de viviendas.

segments.src: Homeowners' ability to afford their mortgage payments has stayed steady over the past seven years.
segments.tr: La capacidad de los propietarios de viviendas para pagar sus hipotecas se ha mantenido constante durante los últimos siete años.

segments.src: Rent hardship, by contrast, has been climbing since 2022.
segments.tr: Las dificultades de alquiler, por el contrario, han estado aumentando desde 2022.

segments.src: Renters also reported strain beyond the rent itself.
segments.tr: Los inquilinos también reportaron estrés más allá del alquiler mismo.

segments.src: More than 20% said they had trouble paying for utilities such as gas, oil, or electricity, which suggests that housing costs are only one part of a broader squeeze on household budgets.
segments.tr: Más del 20% dijo que tuvo dificultades para pagar servicios como gas, petróleo o electricidad, lo que sugiere que los costos de vivienda son solo una parte de una presión más amplia en los presupuestos del hogar.

segments.src: The survey also found that the sharpest increases in missed rent payments during 2025 came in the South and the Northeast.
segments.tr: La encuesta también encontró que los mayores aumentos en pagos de alquiler omitidos durante 2025 se produjeron en el Sur y el Noreste.

segments.src: ## Why Researchers Are Concerned
segments.tr: ## Por qué los investigadores están preocupados

segments.src: The report ties the trend to mounting economic pressures and the rising cost of everyday necessities.
segments.tr: El informe vincula la tendencia a la creciente presión económica y al aumento del costo de las necesidades cotidianas.

segments.src: When groceries, transportation, insurance, and utilities all cost more, rent is often the largest bill to come up short.
segments.tr: Cuando comestibles, transporte, seguros y servicios cuesta más, el alquiler es a menudo la factura más grande que termina siendo insuficiente.

segments.src: Batko also raised a longer-term concern about the shift toward middle-income households, noting the potential implications for the number of people who could eventually lose their housing.
segments.tr: Batko también planteó una preocupación a largo plazo sobre el cambio hacia hogares de ingresos medios, señalando las posibles implicaciones para el número de personas que podrían eventualmente perder su vivienda.

segments.src: Households with more income often have more options, such as savings, credit, or help from family, and researchers watch closely for the point where those cushions run out.
segments.tr: Los hogares con más ingresos a menudo tienen más opciones, como ahorros, crédito o ayuda de la familia, e investigadores monitorean de cerca el punto en el que esos amortiguadores se agotan.

segments.src: ## A Note on the Numbers
segments.tr: ## Una nota sobre los números

segments.src: Reports of this kind rely on self-reported survey responses, so the figures are best read as estimates of how many renters say they struggled, not a count of court filings or formal evictions.
segments.tr: Los informes de este tipo se basan en respuestas de encuestas autoinformadas, por lo que las cifras se leen mejor como estimaciones de cuántos inquilinos dicen que tuvieron dificultades, no una cuenta de presentaciones judiciales o desahucios formales.

segments.src: Some news coverage has summarized the middle-income finding as "one in five," while the underlying data put it slightly higher, at about 22%.
segments.tr: Algunos reportajes de noticias han resumido el hallazgo de ingresos medios como "uno de cada cinco", mientras que los datos subyacentes lo ubican ligeramente más alto, en aproximadamente 22%.

segments.src: The direction of the trend is clear either way.
segments.tr: La dirección de la tendencia es clara de cualquier manera.

segments.src: ## What Renters Can Do
segments.tr: ## Qué pueden hacer los inquilinos

segments.src: Housing costs are not something any one household can fix alone, but a few practical steps can help anyone who expects to fall behind:
segments.tr: Los costos de vivienda no son algo que un solo hogar pueda solucionar solo, pero unos pocos pasos prácticos pueden ayudar a cualquiera que espere quedarse atrás:

segments.src: - **Communicate early.** Landlords and property managers are often more willing to discuss a payment plan before a payment is missed than after.
segments.tr: - **Comunique temprano.** Los propietarios y administradores de propiedades a menudo están más dispuestos a discutir un plan de pago antes de que se pierda un pago que después.

segments.src: - **Know your local options.** Many cities and counties run emergency rental assistance or mediation programs. Dialing 211 in most areas connects callers to local support services.
segments.tr: - **Conozca sus opciones locales.** Muchas ciudades y condados operan programas de asistencia de alquiler de emergencia o mediación. Marcar 211 en la mayoría de las áreas conecta a las personas que llaman con servicios de apoyo local.

segments.src: - **Seek free housing counseling.** HUD-approved housing counseling agencies offer free or low-cost guidance. A directory is available at hud.gov.
segments.tr: - **Busque asesoramiento de vivienda gratuito.** Las agencias de asesoramiento de vivienda aprobadas por HUD ofrecen orientación gratuita o de bajo costo. Un directorio está disponible en hud.gov.

segments.src: - **Review the lease.** Understanding late-fee rules and notice requirements in your state can help you plan.
segments.tr: - **Revise el contrato de arrendamiento.** Comprender las reglas de tarifas por retraso y los requisitos de notificación en su estado puede ayudarle a planificar.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: The Urban Institute's findings add to a growing body of evidence that housing affordability is no longer only a low-income issue.
segments.tr: Los hallazgos del Urban Institute se suman a un cuerpo creciente de evidencia que la asequibilidad de la vivienda ya no es solo un problema de bajos ingresos.

segments.src: With about 22% of middle-income renters reporting a missed or incomplete rent payment last year, the strain now reaches households that were once considered financially secure.
segments.tr: Con aproximadamente 22% de los inquilinos de ingresos medios informando un pago de alquiler omitido o incompleto el año pasado, la presión ahora llega a hogares que alguna vez se consideraban financieramente seguros.

segments.src: Whether the trend continues will depend on rents, wages, and the cost of other basics in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Si la tendencia continúa dependerá de los alquileres, los salarios y el costo de otros básicos en los meses venideros.

segments.src: *Source: Urban Institute Well-Being and Basic Needs Survey, as reported by [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/09/23/nx-s1-5977022/rent-affordability-middle-income) on September 23, 2026.

segments.tr: ثانياً، الزيادة للمستأجرين ذوي الدخل المنخفض، على الرغم من أنها حقيقية، كانت أكثر تدرجاً: من حوالي 24% في 2019 إلى حوالي 28% في 2025.

segments.src: Lower-income renters still report the highest overall rates of trouble paying rent, but the gap between the two groups is narrowing.
segments.tr: لا يزال المستأجرون ذوو الدخل المنخفض يبلغون عن أعلى معدلات المشاكل الكلية في دفع الإيجار، لكن الفجوة بين المجموعتين تتناقص.

segments.src: ## Who Counts as "Middle-Income"?
segments.tr: ## من يُعتبر "متوسط الدخل"؟

segments.src: The report defines middle-income adults by household size.
segments.tr: يعرّف التقرير البالغين ذوي الدخل المتوسط من خلال حجم الأسرة.

segments.src: For a single person, that means earning roughly $31,300 to $62,600 a year.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لشخص واحد، يعني ذلك كسب ما يقارب 31,300 دولار إلى 62,600 دولار سنوياً.

segments.src: For a family of three, the range is roughly $53,300 to $106,600.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لأسرة مكونة من ثلاثة أفراد، يتراوح النطاق بحوالي 53,300 دولار إلى 106,600 دولار.

segments.src: Households in these ranges often earn too much to qualify for many housing assistance programs, yet not enough to absorb a sudden jump in rent, a rise in utility bills, or an unexpected expense.
segments.tr: الأسر في هذه النطاقات غالباً ما تكسب أموالاً كثيرة جداً للتأهل للعديد من برامج المساعدة السكنية، ولكن ليس كفاية لامتصاص قفزة مفاجئة في الإيجار أو ارتفاع في فواتير المرافق أو نفقة غير متوقعة.

segments.src: That makes them especially exposed when several costs climb at once.
segments.tr: هذا يجعلهم معرضين بشكل خاص عندما تترافع عدة تكاليف في نفس الوقت.

segments.src: ## What "Unable to Pay" Means
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني "عدم القدرة على الدفع"

segments.src: In the survey, a renter counts as unable to pay if they could not cover the full amount of rent when it was due.
segments.tr: في الاستطلاع، يُعتبر المستأجر غير قادر على الدفع إذا لم يتمكن من تغطية المبلغ الكامل للإيجار عند استحقاقه.

segments.src: That covers a range of situations, including a late payment, a partial payment, or a missed payment.
segments.tr: هذا يغطي مجموعة من الحالات، بما في ذلك دفع متأخر أو دفع جزئي أو دفع مفقود.

segments.src: Not every case ends in a formal eviction filing, and many households catch up later.
segments.tr: لا تنتهي كل حالة بتقديم طلب إخلاء رسمي، وتتمكن العديد من الأسر من اللحاق لاحقاً.

segments.src: Still, researchers treat these moments as an early warning sign.
segments.tr: مع ذلك، يعامل الباحثون هذه اللحظات كإشارة تحذير مبكرة.

segments.src: Samantha Batko, a senior fellow at the Urban Institute and a co-author of the report, described the change this way: "This increase among middle-income renters is a big and important shift that reflects overall challenges with affordability in the country."
segments.tr: وصفت سامانثا باتكو، زميلة أقدم في معهد الحضر والمؤلفة المشاركة للتقرير، التغيير بهذه الطريقة: "هذه الزيادة بين المستأجرين ذوي الدخل المتوسط تمثل تحولاً كبيراً وهاماً يعكس التحديات الشاملة المتعلقة بالقدرة على تحمل التكاليف في البلاد."

segments.src: She also noted that when a family reports a late, partial, or missed rent payment, those are choices happening in real time as households try to stretch their budgets.
segments.tr: لاحظت أيضاً أنه عندما تبلغ الأسرة عن دفع إيجار متأخر أو جزئي أو مفقود، فهذه خيارات تحدث في الوقت الفعلي عندما تحاول الأسر تمديد ميزانياتها.

segments.src: ## A Trend Specific to Renters
segments.tr: ## اتجاه خاص بالمستأجرين

segments.src: The report points to a gap between renters and homeowners.
segments.tr: يشير التقرير إلى فجوة بين المستأجرين والمالكين.

segments.src: Homeowners' ability to afford their mortgage payments has stayed steady over the past seven years.
segments.tr: ظلت قدرة المالكين على تحمل مدفوعات الرهن العقاري مستقرة على مدى السنوات السبع الماضية.

segments.src: Rent hardship, by contrast, has been climbing since 2022.
segments.tr: من ناحية أخرى، كانت صعوبات الإيجار في ارتفاع مستمر منذ عام 2022.

segments.src: Renters also reported strain beyond the rent itself.
segments.tr: أبلغ المستأجرون أيضاً عن ضغط يتجاوز الإيجار نفسه.

segments.src: More than 20% said they had trouble paying for utilities such as gas, oil, or electricity, which suggests that housing costs are only one part of a broader squeeze on household budgets.
segments.tr: قال أكثر من 20% أنهم واجهوا مشاكل في دفع تكاليف المرافق مثل الغاز أو الزيت أو الكهرباء، مما يشير إلى أن تكاليف السكن هي جزء واحد فقط من ضغط أوسع على ميزانيات الأسر.

segments.src: The survey also found that the sharpest increases in missed rent payments during 2025 came in the South and the Northeast.
segments.tr: وجد الاستطلاع أيضاً أن أكبر الزيادات في دفعات الإيجار المفقودة خلال عام 2025 حدثت في الجنوب والشمال الشرقي.

segments.src: ## Why Researchers Are Concerned
segments.tr: ## لماذا يثير هذا قلق الباحثين

segments.src: The report ties the trend to mounting economic pressures and the rising cost of everyday necessities.
segments.tr: يربط التقرير الاتجاه بالضغوط الاقتصادية المتزايدة والتكاليف المرتفعة للضروريات اليومية.

segments.src: When groceries, transportation, insurance, and utilities all cost more, rent is often the largest bill to come up short.
segments.tr: عندما تكون تكاليف البقالة والنقل والتأمين والمرافق أعلى، غالباً ما يكون الإيجار أكبر فاتورة تواجه نقصاً.

segments.src: Batko also raised a longer-term concern about the shift toward middle-income households, noting the potential implications for the number of people who could eventually lose their housing.
segments.tr: أثارت باتكو أيضاً قلقاً طويل الأمد بشأن التحول نحو الأسر متوسطة الدخل، مشيرة إلى الآثار المحتملة على عدد الأشخاص الذين قد يفقدون مسكنهم في النهاية.

segments.src: Households with more income often have more options, such as savings, credit, or help from family, and researchers watch closely for the point where those cushions run out.
segments.tr: غالباً ما تتمتع الأسر ذات الدخل الأعلى بخيارات أكثر، مثل المدخرات أو الائتمان أو المساعدة من الأسرة، والباحثون يراقبون عن كثب النقطة التي تنفد فيها هذه الخيارات.

segments.src: ## A Note on the Numbers
segments.tr: ## ملاحظة حول الأرقام

segments.src: Reports of this kind rely on self-reported survey responses, so the figures are best read as estimates of how many renters say they struggled, not a count of court filings or formal evictions.
segments.tr: تعتمد التقارير من هذا النوع على ردود استطلاع ذاتية التقرير، لذلك يُفضل قراءة الأرقام كتقديرات لعدد المستأجرين الذين قالوا أنهم كافحوا، وليس عداً لطلبات المحاكم أو عمليات الإخلاء الرسمية.

segments.src: Some news coverage has summarized the middle-income finding as "one in five," while the underlying data put it slightly higher, at about 22%.
segments.tr: قامت بعض وسائل الإعلام بتلخيص النتيجة متوسطة الدخل بأنها "واحد من بين كل خمسة"، بينما تضع البيانات الأساسية أعلى قليلاً، بحوالي 22%.

segments.src: The direction of the trend is clear either way.
segments.tr: اتجاه الاتجاه واضح بأي حال من الأحوال.

segments.src: ## What Renters Can Do
segments.tr: ## ما يمكن للمستأجرين فعله

segments.src: Housing costs are not something any one household can fix alone, but a few practical steps can help anyone who expects to fall behind:
segments.tr: تكاليف السكن ليست شيئاً يمكن لأي أسرة واحدة أن تصلحه وحدها، لكن بعض الخطوات العملية يمكن أن تساعد أي شخص يتوقع أن يتخلف عن الركب:

segments.src: - **Communicate early.** Landlords and property managers are often more willing to discuss a payment plan before a payment is missed than after.
segments.tr: - **تواصل مبكراً.** غالباً ما يكون المالكون ومديرو العقارات أكثر استعداداً لمناقشة خطة الدفع قبل تفويت الدفع بدلاً من بعده.

segments.src: - **Know your local options.** Many cities and counties run emergency rental assistance or mediation programs. Dialing 211 in most areas connects callers to local support services.
segments.tr: - **تعرف على خياراتك المحلية.** تدير العديد من المدن والمقاطعات برامج مساعدة إيجار طارئة أو وساطة. يربط الاتصال برقم 211 في معظم المناطق المتصلين بخدمات الدعم المحلية.

segments.src: - **Seek free housing counseling.** HUD-approved housing counseling agencies offer free or low-cost guidance. A directory is available at hud.gov.
segments.tr: - **ابحث عن استشارات سكنية مجانية.** توفر وكالات استشارات السكن المعتمدة من HUD إرشادات مجانية أو منخفضة التكلفة. يتوفر الدليل على hud.gov.

segments.src: - **Review the lease.** Understanding late-fee rules and notice requirements in your state can help you plan.
segments.tr: - **راجع الإيجار.** يمكن أن يساعدك فهم قواعد الرسوم المتأخرة ومتطلبات الإشعار في ولايتك على التخطيط.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The Urban Institute's findings add to a growing body of evidence that housing affordability is no longer only a low-income issue.
segments.tr: تضيف نتائج معهد الحضر إلى مجموعة متزايدة من الأدلة على أن القدرة على تحمل تكاليف السكن لم تعد مشكلة تقتصر على ذوي الدخل المنخفض.

segments.src: With about 22% of middle-income renters reporting a missed or incomplete rent payment last year, the strain now reaches households that were once considered financially secure.
segments.tr: مع أن حوالي 22% من المستأجرين ذوي الدخل المتوسط أبلغوا عن دفعة إيجار مفقودة أو غير كاملة في العام الماضي، الضغط يصل الآن إلى الأسر التي كانت تُعتبر مالياً آمنة ذات مرة.

segments.src: Whether the trend continues will depend on rents, wages, and the cost of other basics in the months ahead.
segments.tr: ما إذا استمر الاتجاه سيعتمد على الإيجارات والأجور وتكاليف الضروريات الأخرى في الأشهر القادمة.

segments.src: *Source: Urban Institute Well-Being and Basic Needs Survey, as reported by [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/09/23/nx-s1-5977022/rent-affordability-middle-income) on September 23, 2026.
segments.tr: *المصدر: استطلاع الرفاهية والاحتياجات الأساسية بمعهد الحضر، كما أبلغت عنه [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/09/23/nx-s1-5977022/rent-affordability-middle-income) في 23 سبتمبر 2026.

segments.src: This article is for general information only and does not constitute financial or legal advice.*
segments.tr: هذه المقالة لأغراض المعلومات العامة فقط ولا تشكل نصيحة مالية أو قانونية.*

fr.title: Plus d'une personne sur cinq parmi les locataires à revenus intermédiaires n'a pas pu payer un loyer complet l'année dernière, selon un nouveau rapport de l'Urban Institute

segments.src: For years, the conversation about rent hardship in America focused mostly on lower-income households.
segments.tr: Pendant des années, la conversation sur les difficultés de loyer en Amérique s'est concentrée principalement sur les ménages à revenus plus faibles.

segments.src: A new report from the Urban Institute suggests the pressure is now reaching much further up the income ladder.
segments.tr: Un nouveau rapport de l'Urban Institute suggère que la pression atteint désormais beaucoup plus haut dans l'échelle des revenus.

segments.src: According to the organization's latest survey data, roughly 22% of middle-income renters said that at some point in 2025 they could not pay their full rent when it was due.
segments.tr: Selon les dernières données d'enquête de l'organisation, environ 22 % des locataires à revenus intermédiaires ont déclaré qu'à un moment donné en 2025, ils ne pouvaient pas payer leur loyer complet à l'échéance.

segments.src: That is a sharp change from the year before, and it is a bigger jump than the one seen among lower-income renters.
segments.tr: C'est un changement brutal par rapport à l'année précédente, et c'est une augmentation plus importante que celle observée parmi les locataires à revenus plus faibles.

segments.src: Here is what the findings say, who is affected, and why researchers are paying close attention.
segments.tr: Voici ce que révèlent les résultats, qui est touché et pourquoi les chercheurs y accordent une attention particulière.

segments.src: ## The Key Numbers
segments.tr: ## Les chiffres clés

segments.src: The findings come from the Urban Institute's Well-Being and Basic Needs Survey, which asked more than 10,000 adults about how they are managing everyday costs.
segments.tr: Les résultats proviennent de l'enquête Well-Being and Basic Needs Survey de l'Urban Institute, qui a interrogé plus de 10 000 adultes sur la façon dont ils gèrent les coûts quotidiens.

segments.src: The share of renters who said they were unable to pay the full amount of rent at least once in the year breaks down as follows:
segments.tr: La proportion de locataires qui ont déclaré ne pas pouvoir payer le montant complet du loyer au moins une fois dans l'année se répartit comme suit :

segments.src: | Renter group | Earlier figure | 2025 |
segments.tr: | Groupe de locataires | Chiffre antérieur | 2025 |

segments.src: | Middle-income | about 14% (prior year) | about 22% |
segments.tr: | Revenus intermédiaires | environ 14 % (année précédente) | environ 22 % |

segments.src: | Lower-income | about 24% (2019) | about 28% |
segments.tr: | Revenus faibles | environ 24 % (2019) | environ 28 % |

segments.src: | Higher-earning | about 5% (prior year) | about 7% |
segments.tr: | Revenus élevés | environ 5 % (année précédente) | environ 7 % |

segments.src: Two things stand out.
segments.tr: Deux choses se démarquent.

segments.src: First, middle-income renters saw a rise of roughly eight percentage points in a single year.
segments.tr: Premièrement, les locataires à revenus intermédiaires ont connu une augmentation d'environ huit points de pourcentage en un seul an.

segments.src: Second, the increase for lower-income renters, while real, has been much more gradual: from about 24% in 2019 to about 28% in 2025.
segments.tr: Deuxièmement, l'augmentation pour les locataires à revenus plus faibles, bien que réelle, a été beaucoup plus graduelle : de environ 24 % en 2019 à environ 28 % en 2025.

segments.src: Lower-income renters still report the highest overall rates of trouble paying rent, but the gap between the two groups is narrowing.
segments.tr: Les locataires à revenus plus faibles signalent toujours les taux les plus élevés de difficultés à payer le loyer, mais l'écart entre les deux groupes se rétrécit.

segments.src: ## Who Counts as "Middle-Income"?
segments.tr: ## Qui est considéré comme ayant des « revenus intermédiaires » ?

segments.src: The report defines middle-income adults by household size.
segments.tr: Le rapport définit les adultes à revenus intermédiaires par la taille du ménage.

segments.src: For a single person, that means earning roughly $31,300 to $62,600 a year.
segments.tr: Pour une seule personne, cela signifie gagner environ $31 300 à $62 600 par an.

segments.src: For a family of three, the range is roughly $53,300 to $106,600.
segments.tr: Pour une famille de trois personnes, la plage est d'environ $53 300 à $106 600.

segments.src: Households in these ranges often earn too much to qualify for many housing assistance programs, yet not enough to absorb a sudden jump in rent, a rise in utility bills, or an unexpected expense.
segments.tr: Les ménages dans ces tranches gagnent souvent trop pour être admissibles à de nombreux programmes d'aide au logement, mais pas assez pour absorber une augmentation soudaine du loyer, une hausse des factures de services publics ou une dépense inattendue.

segments.src: That makes them especially exposed when several costs climb at once.
segments.tr: Cela les rend particulièrement vulnérables lorsque plusieurs coûts augmentent à la fois.

segments.src: ## What "Unable to Pay" Means
segments.tr: ## Ce que « Ne pas pouvoir payer » signifie

segments.src: In the survey, a renter counts as unable to pay if they could not cover the full amount of rent when it was due.
segments.tr: Dans l'enquête, un locataire est compté comme ne pouvant pas payer s'il ne pouvait pas couvrir le montant complet du loyer à l'échéance.

segments.src: That covers a range of situations, including a late payment, a partial payment, or a missed payment.
segments.tr: Cela couvre une gamme de situations, y compris un paiement en retard, un paiement partiel ou un paiement manqué.

segments.src: Not every case ends in a formal eviction filing, and many households catch up later.
segments.tr: Tous les cas n'aboutissent pas à un dépôt d'expulsion formel, et de nombreux ménages rattrapent leur retard plus tard.

segments.src: Still, researchers treat these moments as an early warning sign.
segments.tr: Néanmoins, les chercheurs considèrent ces moments comme un signal d'alerte précoce.

segments.src: Samantha Batko, a senior fellow at the Urban Institute and a co-author of the report, described the change this way: "This increase among middle-income renters is a big and important shift that reflects overall challenges with affordability in the country."
segments.tr: Samantha Batko, chercheure principale à l'Urban Institute et co-auteure du rapport, a décrit ce changement ainsi : « Cette augmentation parmi les locataires à revenus intermédiaires est un changement grand et important qui reflète les défis globaux en matière d'accessibilité dans le pays. »

segments.src: She also noted that when a family reports a late, partial, or missed rent payment, those are choices happening in real time as households try to stretch their budgets.
segments.tr: Elle a également noté que lorsqu'une famille signale un paiement de loyer en retard, partiel ou manqué, ce sont des choix qui se font en temps réel alors que les ménages s'effortent de faire tenir leurs budgets.

segments.src: ## A Trend Specific to Renters
segments.tr: ## Une tendance spécifique aux locataires

segments.src: The report points to a gap between renters and homeowners.
segments.tr: Le rapport pointe une différence entre les locataires et les propriétaires occupants.

segments.src: Homeowners' ability to afford their mortgage payments has stayed steady over the past seven years.
segments.tr: La capacité des propriétaires occupants à payer leurs mensualités hypothécaires est restée stable au cours des sept dernières années.

segments.src: Rent hardship, by contrast, has been climbing since 2022.
segments.tr: Les difficultés de loyer, en contraste, ont augmenté depuis 2022.

segments.src: Renters also reported strain beyond the rent itself.
segments.tr: Les locataires ont également signalé une tension au-delà du loyer lui-même.

segments.src: More than 20% said they had trouble paying for utilities such as gas, oil, or electricity, which suggests that housing costs are only one part of a broader squeeze on household budgets.
segments.tr: Plus de 20 % ont déclaré avoir des difficultés à payer les services publics tels que le gaz, le pétrole ou l'électricité, ce qui suggère que les coûts du logement ne sont qu'une partie d'une compression plus large des budgets des ménages.

segments.src: The survey also found that the sharpest increases in missed rent payments during 2025 came in the South and the Northeast.
segments.tr: L'enquête a également révélé que les augmentations les plus importantes des paiements de loyer manqués en 2025 se sont produites dans le Sud et le Nord-Est.

segments.src: ## Why Researchers Are Concerned
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les chercheurs sont préoccupés

segments.src: The report ties the trend to mounting economic pressures and the rising cost of everyday necessities.
segments.tr: Le rapport lie la tendance aux pressions économiques croissantes et à la hausse du coût des nécessités quotidiennes.

segments.src: When groceries, transportation, insurance, and utilities all cost more, rent is often the largest bill to come up short.
segments.tr: Quand l'épicerie, les transports, l'assurance et les services publics coûtent tous plus cher, c'est souvent le loyer qui vient à manquer.

segments.src: Batko also raised a longer-term concern about the shift toward middle-income households, noting the potential implications for the number of people who could eventually lose their housing.
segments.tr: Batko a également soulevé une préoccupation à plus long terme concernant le déplacement vers les ménages à revenus intermédiaires, notant les implications potentielles pour le nombre de personnes qui pourraient éventuellement perdre leur logement.

segments.src: Households with more income often have more options, such as savings, credit, or help from family, and researchers watch closely for the point where those cushions run out.
segments.tr: Les ménages ayant un revenu plus élevé ont souvent plus d'options, comme l'épargne, le crédit ou l'aide familiale, et les chercheurs surveillent de près le moment où ces coussins s'épuisent.

segments.src: ## A Note on the Numbers
segments.tr: ## Une note sur les chiffres

segments.src: Reports of this kind rely on self-reported survey responses, so the figures are best read as estimates of how many renters say they struggled, not a count of court filings or formal evictions.
segments.tr: Les rapports de ce type s'appuient sur des réponses d'enquête auto-déclarées, donc les chiffres sont mieux lus comme des estimations du nombre de locataires qui disent avoir lutté, non pas un compte des dépôts judiciaires ou des expulsions formelles.

segments.src: Some news coverage has summarized the middle-income finding as "one in five," while the underlying data put it slightly higher, at about 22%.
segments.tr: Certains reportages d'actualité ont résumé les résultats relatifs aux revenus intermédiaires comme « une personne sur cinq », tandis que les données sous-jacentes le situent légèrement plus haut, à environ 22 %.

segments.src: The direction of the trend is clear either way.
segments.tr: La direction de la tendance est claire de toute façon.

segments.src: ## What Renters Can Do
segments.tr: ## Ce que les locataires peuvent faire

segments.src: Housing costs are not something any one household can fix alone, but a few practical steps can help anyone who expects to fall behind:
segments.tr: Les coûts du logement ne sont pas quelque chose qu'un seul ménage peut résoudre seul, mais quelques mesures pratiques peuvent aider quiconque risque de prendre du retard :

segments.src: - **Communicate early.** Landlords and property managers are often more willing to discuss a payment plan before a payment is missed than after.
segments.tr: - **Communiquer tôt.** Les propriétaires et les gestionnaires de propriétés sont souvent plus disposés à discuter d'un plan de paiement avant qu'un paiement ne soit manqué qu'après.

segments.src: - **Know your local options.** Many cities and counties run emergency rental assistance or mediation programs. Dialing 211 in most areas connects callers to local support services.
segments.tr: - **Connaître vos options locales.** De nombreuses villes et comtés gèrent des programmes d'aide locative d'urgence ou de médiation. Composer le 211 dans la plupart des zones connecte les appelants aux services d'assistance locaux.

segments.src: - **Seek free housing counseling.** HUD-approved housing counseling agencies offer free or low-cost guidance. A directory is available at hud.gov.
segments.tr: - **Chercher des conseils en matière de logement gratuits.** Les agences de conseils en matière de logement agréées par HUD offrent des conseils gratuits ou à faible coût. Un répertoire est disponible sur hud.gov.
